_comment: Starting point for cold-start variance tracking, not a strict SLA.
Recorded from one manual run of :baselineprofile:connectedNonMinifiedReleaseAndroidTest
API 34, 5 iterations per CompilationMode. A prior hand-measurement with adb `am start -W`
found run-to-run deltas of roughly 100-340ms across separate emulator-boot sessions, so a
single number here should not be read as precise — it exists so the new CI job
(macrobenchmark-startup, non-gating) has something to diff against. Revise these numbers
once a handful of real CI runs establish actual environment variance; until then this file
is informational only and nothing reads or enforces it automatically.
